title: Regret May Cry 2
author: Chinoui67
selftext:
i've been having so much fun trying to make the modern pixel art game  i would love to play ... which is a mix of Escape from Tarkov, Devil May Cry, Moonstone island and Vampire survivor in a multiplayer open world ?

Still an early prototypes but i've sank many hours already just playing it and fine tuning it until felt awesome.. first for combat..then for sound .. then for fx.. then for the classes, then for balancing the farm ..and it has been a pretty fun process wondering why fishing was fun and why a mage is different from a warrior

Runs on IOS, Android, Linux, MacOS , Windows... on a browser ( even have a lighter hd filter for phones to handle ), vibrations, Hosted on a free cloudflare plan that could handle 200 players.... i don't have that many friends

many features i don't have time to show in a 3min vid tolerated by reddit like arena , 2v2 pvp , wings, raids , abyss...

I wish i acheive my dream game and have friends with a legal copy of the game try and enjoy it as much as i did !
